metadata.topic: Please simulate Northstar Platform, a 5-engineer Python/FastAPI platform team, and evaluate whether the GitHub repository langchain-ai/langgraph should be piloted as the workflow runtime for an internal open-source adoption memo and technical decision research desk. Combine local team constraints, public documentation or GitHub/Web evidence, whether graph structure is actually necessary, risks, a pilot plan, and a rollback plan.

message: Build the plan and research brief.

handoff.reason: Build the plan and research brief.

metadata.research_brief: Evaluate whether langchain-ai/langgraph should be piloted as the workflow runtime for Northstar Platform — a 5-engineer Python/FastAPI platform team — to inform an internal open-source adoption memo and technical decision research desk. The evaluation must integrate: (1) team-specific constraints (size, stack, operational capacity), (2) public evidence from GitHub, docs, and ecosystem signals, (3) necessity analysis of graph-based workflows vs. simpler alternatives, (4) concrete pilot and rollback plans, and (5) grounding in available private context documents (e.g., agent-workflow-decision-context.md, platform-team-constraints.md). Output must support a concise, evidence-backed recommendation suitable for engineering leadership review.

message: Decide which research units to delegate and which evidence tools each unit should use.

handoff.reason: Decide which research units to delegate and which evidence tools each unit should use.

tool_calls.name: think_tool
tool_calls.rationale: Ensure the ODR-style supervisor records a reflection before delegation.
tool_calls.reflection: The research plan is well-structured and covers all critical dimensions: team constraints (p1), technical necessity and maturity (p2), pilot feasibility (p3), and operational safety via rollback (p4). All four items require hybrid evidence — combining internal documentation (e.g., platform-team-constraints.md) with up-to-date public signals (GitHub activity, langchain.dev docs, issue tracker patterns). The internal corpus is small but high-signal (3 docs, all contextually relevant), and the web queries are precise enough to surface production-readiness indicators (e.g., 'debug', 'observability', 'rollback'). No plan item is redundant or under-scoped. Before delegating, I must ensure each ConductResearch call strictly adheres to the specified min_evidence=2, min_sources=1, and sufficiency criteria — especially preserving citations and balancing external + internal evidence. Since all four items are pending and interdependent, I will launch parallel research units with max_concurrent_research_units=4.

tool_calls.name: ConductResearch
tool_calls.rationale: Initiate parallel, targeted research for plan item p1 to ground evaluation in Northstar’s documented constraints. Hybrid mode is essential: vector_retrieval will extract precise excerpts from internal team-context files (e.g., platform-team-constraints.md), while web_search validates freshness and detects any publicly disclosed constraints not captured internally. Web query focuses on exact file paths and keywords; internal query leverages semantic similarity over full context prompts to surface constraint-related passages. Min_evidence=2 ensures at least one internal and one external citation, satisfying sufficiency criteria.
tool_calls.research_topic: Northstar Platform’s explicit technical, operational, and staffing constraints for workflow orchestration
web_queries: site:examples/adoption-lab/team-context/ platform-team-constraints.md OR agent-workflow-decision-context.md workflow constraints
Northstar Platform FastAPI workflow deployment velocity constraints site:github.com
internal_queries: What are Northstar Platform’s explicit technical, operational, and staffing constraints — particularly around workflow orchestration, observability, deployment velocity, and maintenance bandwidth — as documented in internal team-context files?
platform-team-constraints.md constraints on Python dependencies, deployment time, or FastAPI integration
sufficiency_criteria: collect at least 2 evidence items for this plan item
use at least 1 source group(s) when available
preserve citations for report assembly
prefer evidence from both external search and contextual retrieval

tool_calls.name: ConductResearch
tool_calls.rationale: Launch concurrent research for p2 to assess whether langgraph’s graph semantics are necessary and production-ready for Northstar’s scale. GitHub activity (stars, open issues, recent PRs) and official docs are primary signals for maturity and debugging capability. Web queries target concrete terms ('state graph', 'debug', 'production') to filter noise; internal query cross-references adoption checklist criteria for 'operational burden' and 'debuggability'. Vector_retrieval will surface any internal risk assessments of stateful workflows. Min_evidence=2 ensures at least one GitHub signal (e.g., issue about observability gaps) and one doc-based validation (e.g., langchain.dev tutorial limitations).

langgraph vs Celery FastAPI background tasks comparison site:github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph/issues

open-source-adoption-checklist.md criteria for 'debuggability' and 'operational burden' applied to langgraph
sufficiency_criteria: collect at least 2 evidence items for this plan item
use at least 1 source group(s) when available
preserve citations for report assembly

tool_calls.name: ConductResearch
tool_calls.rationale: Execute p3 research to define a minimal, observable pilot. Official langchain.dev documentation is the highest-fidelity source for integration patterns and observability hooks. Web queries prioritize 'minimal example' and 'FastAPI integration' to avoid over-engineered tutorials. Internal query checks for alignment with Northstar’s 'incremental validation' principle from the adoption checklist. Vector_retrieval will surface any prior internal POC notes or instrumentation standards. Min_evidence=2 ensures one working code pattern (e.g., LangGraph + FastAPI endpoint) and one success metric definition (e.g., latency SLO or trace coverage).

use at least 1 source group(s) when available

tool_calls.name: ConductResearch
tool_calls.rationale: Defer p4 research to confirm rollback mechanics are actionable and aligned with internal incident response. Public evidence from langgraph’s repo (issues, discussions, PRs) is most likely to contain migration guidance or uninstall patterns. Web query targets 'rollback' and 'migrate away' to surface community-validated approaches. Internal query retrieves Northstar’s dependency hygiene policy and incident runbook clauses that constrain deprecation timelines or rollback verification steps. Min_evidence=2 ensures one langgraph-specific removal pattern and one internal policy citation (e.g., 'all runtime dependencies must have <1hr rollback SLA').
